question: The city of _______ was located on Khadir Beyt (also spelled as Bet) in the Rann of Kutch, where there was fresh water and fertile soil.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dholavira**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dholavira** is one of the five largest Harappan sites and the most prominent archaeological site in India belonging to the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• The site is located on **Khadir Beyt** in the Rann of Kutch, where there was fresh water and fertile soil, making it an ideal location for settlement.
 
• Dholavira is known for its sophisticated water conservation systems, including reservoirs and step wells.
 
• The site also features a unique layout with a citadel, middle town, and lower town, showcasing advanced urban planning.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lothal**

 
 
• Another significant site of the Indus Valley Civilization, known for its dockyard.
 
• Located in the present-day state of Gujarat, India.
 
 
 
• **Harappa**
 
 
• One of the first sites of the Indus Valley Civilization to be discovered.
 
• Located in present-day Pakistan.
 
 
 
• **Mohenjodaro**
 
 
• Another major site of the Indus Valley Civilization.
 
• Known for its advanced urban infrastructure.
 
• Located in present-day Sindh, Pakistan.
